name: mirror-matrix
title: Intercompany mirror matrix
description: Square matrix comparing reciprocal balances between entities, with billed entities across columns and billing entities down rows.
needs: A numeric measure and two-level groups ([rowEntity, columnEntity]).

text.title: {left} against {right}
text.lede: Rows are {leftShort}. Columns are {rightShort}. Each cell holds one relationship seen from both ends. Until a cell agrees, the pair cannot be eliminated on consolidation.

options.name: divisor
options.description: Divide matrix cell amounts by this number (e.g. 1000 for thousands).
